title: [3.0-beta6] SMB are converted to meal bolus on app restart
symptom: When restarting AAPS, all past SMB are converted to meal bolus in the graph. This happens after the pump history is read from the Combo.
cause: The issue was specific to the Combo pump driver, where reading pump history on app start caused SMB to be converted to meal bolus.
evidence_quote: it was combo specific issue. fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/f5faa3492288b97b49284e116c29720f50194560
